entries.Original: Lodestone Verification is needed for your currently logged in character:
entries.Translated: 您当前登录的角色需要磁石验证：

entries.Original: You can suppress this dialog at /sonarconfig General tab, Lodestone Settings.
entries.Translated: 您可以在 /sonarconfig 常规选项卡的 Lodestone 设置中抑制此对话框。

entries.Original: Please contact Sonar support for assistance.
entries.Translated: 请联系 Sonar 支持人员寻求帮助。

entries.Original: Your character is currently not verified.
entries.Translated: 您的角色目前尚未验证。

entries.Original: Your character lodestone profile is not found.
entries.Translated: 未找到您的角色磁石资料。

entries.Original: Make your character's Lodestone profile searchable and public. You can set it back to private after verification is done.
entries.Translated: 让你的角色的磁石个人资料可搜索且公开。验证完成后，您可以将其设置回私密状态。

entries.Original: Your character lodestone profile is private.
entries.Translated: 您的角色磁石资料是私人的。

entries.Original: Make your Lodestone profile public to be able to verify. You can set it back to private after verification is done.
entries.Translated: 公开您的 Lodestone 个人资料以便进行验证。验证完成后，您可以将其设置回私密状态。

entries.Original: Your character has been renamed and your character's lodestone profile is private.
entries.Translated: 您的角色已被重命名，并且您角色的磁石个人资料是私人的。

entries.Original: Your character hash mismatch and your character's lodestone profile is private.
entries.Translated: 您的角色哈希不匹配，并且您角色的磁石个人资料是私有的。

entries.Original: Your character lodestone information stored at Sonar is stale.
entries.Translated: 您存储在声纳中的角色磁石信息已过时。

entries.Original: Update your Sonar plugin or contact support for assistance.
entries.Translated: 更新您的 Sonar 插件或联系支持人员寻求帮助。

entries.Original: Add the following code into your chracter's lodestone profile bio:
entries.Translated: 将以下代码添加到角色的磁石个人资料中：

entries.Original: This verification will become a requirement in
entries.Translated: 此验证将成为一项要求

entries.Original: This verification will become a requirement in less than 5 minutes.
entries.Translated: 此验证将在 5 分钟内成为一项要求。

entries.Original: This verification is not a requirement at this time.
entries.Translated: 目前不要求进行此验证。

entries.Original: You'll only be able to use Sonar in local mode if not verified by the time this becomes a requirement.
entries.Translated: 如果在成为要求时尚未经过验证，您将只能在本地模式下使用声纳。

entries.Original: - Lots of strings are still not covered
entries.Translated: - 很多字符串仍未被覆盖
- 字符串可能会在版本之间发生变化

entries.Original: Use localization at your own risk!
entries.Translated: 使用本地化需要您自担风险！

entries.Original: Separate Rank SS and Minions from Rank S
entries.Translated: 将 SS 级与 S 级、宠物分开

entries.Original: All timers are in seconds. CTRL+Click to input directly.
entries.Translated: 所有计时器均以秒为单位。 CTRL+点击直接输入。
死亡后经过时间（S 和 A）

entries.Original: Time since last update (S and A)
entries.Translated: 上次更新后经过时间（S 和 A）
完成或失败后经过时间
选择聊天的 {0} 个命运

entries.Original: {0} fate(s) not set to default jurisdiction
entries.Translated: {0} 个命运未设置为默认管辖区

entries.Original: Brought to you by the Sonar Team

entries.Translated: 声纳支持 Discord##声纳 Discord

entries.Original:
Ask questions and report bugs at the Sonar Support Discord Server.
Note that Sonar Support is not provided in the goat place's discord.
entries.Translated:
在 Sonar 支持 Discord 服务器上提出问题并报告错误。
请注意，山羊地方的不和谐中不提供声纳支持。

entries.Original:
Support Sonar on Patreon.
Earnings will be used for the hosting costs of the Sonar Server and Discord Bots.
entries.Translated:
在 Patreon 上支持声纳。
收入将用于支付 Sonar 服务器和 Discord 机器人的托管成本。

entries.Original: Sonar will keep trying to reconnect automatically
entries.Translated: 声纳将继续尝试自动重新连接

entries.Original: Signal Sonar to attempt reconnecting to server
entries.Translated: 向 Sonar 发出信号以尝试重新连接到服务器

entries.Original:
Perform a consistency check of the index
Output will be at /xllog
entries.Translated:
执行索引的一致性检查
输出将位于 /xllog

entries.Original:
Rebuild index
Output will be at /xllog

Warning: You may experience stuttering
entries.Translated:
重建索引
输出将位于 /xllog

警告：您可能会出现口吃的情况

entries.Original:
Request all relay information to be received.
Track All options will automatically be enabled for both Hunts and Fates.
This can only be done once.

Warning: You'll receive everything the Sonar server knows!
This is currently under testing.
entries.Translated:
请求接收所有中继信息。
追踪所有选项将自动为狩猎和命运启用。
此操作只能进行一次。

警告：您将收到声纳服务器知道的所有内容！
目前该功能正在测试中。

entries.Original: Right now there's nothing useful in this window but I'll be working on this next release. In the meantime enjoy the filtering selector and hunt/fates counts
entries.Translated: 现在这个窗口中没有任何有用的东西，但我将致力于下一个版本。同时享受过滤选择器和狩猎/命运计数

entries.Original:
We cannot contact you in-game.
Provide an external method of contact.
entries.Translated:
我们无法在游戏中联系您。
提供外部联系方式。

attributes.Original:
Uses FFXIV's audio engine to play the game's built in sound effects.
Uses FFXIV's system sounds volume.
attributes.Translated:
使用 FFXIV 的音频引擎来播放游戏的内置音效。
使用 FFXIV 的系统音量。

attributes.Original:
Uses Sonar's audio engine to play previously included sound effects.
Uses Sonar's alert volume.
attributes.Translated:
使用 Sonar 的音频引擎播放之前包含的音效。
使用声纳的警报音量。

attributes.Original:
Uses Sonar's audio engine to play a custom sound effect.
Uses Sonar's alert volume.
attributes.Translated:
使用Sonar的音频引擎来播放自定义音效。
使用声纳的警报音量。

attributes.Original: Contact Sonar Support should this appear
attributes.Translated: 如果出现此信息，请联系 Sonar 支持

attributes.Original:
Disable this to disable contributing both hunts and fates.
Accessible via /sonaron and /sonaroff commands.
attributes.Translated:
禁用此选项可禁用对狩猎和命运的贡献。
可通过 /sonaron 和 /sonaroff 命令访问。

attributes.Original:
Contributing reports is required in order to receive reports from other Sonar users.
If disabled Sonar will continue to work in local mode, where you'll see what's detected within your game but you'll not receive from others.
attributes.Translated:
为了接收其他 Sonar 用户的报告，需要提供报告。
如果禁用，声纳将继续在本地模式下工作，您将看到游戏中检测到的内容，但不会收到其他人的信息。

attributes.Original:
Checked: Track all reports regardless of jurisdiction settings.
Unchecked: Track reports within jurisdiction settings only.
attributes.Translated:
选中：跟踪所有报告，无论管辖区设置如何。
未选中：仅跟踪管辖范围内的报告。
在执勤期间禁用聊天警报
在执勤期间禁用声音警报
在游戏聊天中显示报告

attributes.Original: Use crossworld icon when report is in another world
attributes.Translated: 当报告位于另一个世界时使用跨世界图标
传送至最近的以太之光

attributes.Original: Remove hunt from the list until next update
attributes.Translated: 从列表中移除该狩猎，直到下次更新

attributes.Original: Use debug fallbacks, showing the keys.
attributes.Translated: 使用调试默认文本，直接显示本地化键。

attributes.Original: Run language setup in a separate thread.
attributes.Translated: 在独立线程中初始化语言。

attributes.Original: World then Zone then Instance then Relay IDs
attributes.Translated: 服务器、区域、副本实例、报告

attributes.Original: Zone then Instance then Relay IDs
Jurisdiction then World then Zone then Instance then Relay IDs
attributes.Translated: 接收范围、服务器、区域、副本实例、报告
未知原因，正常情况下不应出现。

attributes.Original: This character is not verified. You need to make your lodestone profile visible and searchable for verification to work. You can make your lodestone profile private again after verification.
attributes.Translated: 该角色尚未验证。请将 Lodestone 角色资料设为公开且可搜索，以便完成验证。验证后可重新设为私密。

attributes.Original: Your character profile could not be found. You need to make your lodestone profile visible and searchable for verification to work. You can make your lodestone profile private again after verification.
attributes.Translated: 未找到您的角色资料。请将 Lodestone 角色资料设为公开且可搜索，以便完成验证。验证后可重新设为私密。

attributes.Original: Your character profile is found but its currently private. You need to make your lodestone profile visible and searchable for verification to work. You can make your lodestone profile private again after verification.
attributes.Translated: 已找到您的角色资料，但目前为私密。请将 Lodestone 角色资料设为公开且可搜索，以便完成验证。验证后可重新设为私密。

attributes.Original: Request is the result of a rename. You need to make your lodestone profile visible. You can make your lodestone profile private again after verification.
attributes.Translated: 角色改名后需要重新验证。请将 Lodestone 角色资料设为公开，验证后可重新设为私密。

attributes.Original: Character hash mismatch and your lodestone profile is private. You need to make your lodestone profile visible. You can make your lodestone profile private again after verification.
attributes.Translated: 角色哈希不匹配，且 Lodestone 角色资料为私密。请将资料设为公开，验证后可重新设为私密。

attributes.Original: Character information is stale. You need to make your lodestone profile visible. You can make your lodestone profile private again after verification.
attributes.Translated: 角色信息已过期。请将 Lodestone 角色资料设为公开，验证后可重新设为私密。
